martial.name: Warrior
martial.has: More attack damage; shields slow you less.
ideas: War Cry
Shout: you and allies within 8 blocks get Strength I for 8 s; enemies within 8 blocks get Weakness I for 5 s.
Shield Bash
Strike with your shield: the enemy in front takes 4 damage, is knocked back 3 blocks and is stunned for 1 s. Needs a shield.
Second Wind
Instantly restore 30% of your stamina and heal 4. Works only below half health.
Cleaving Blow
Your next melee hit within 5 s also hits every enemy within 3 blocks of the target for 60% of its damage.
Battle Stance
For 10 s: +2 armour and +10% attack damage, but -10% movement speed.
Challenge
Taunt every enemy within 10 blocks to attack you for 6 s; you take 15% less damage while they do.

martial.name: Archer
martial.has: No arrow spread; bows slow you less.
ideas: Focused Shot
Your next arrow within 6 s deals +50% damage and makes the target glow for 8 s.
Arrow Rain
A volley of 10 arrows falls on the spot you look at (within 24 blocks), spread over 4 blocks.
Pinning Shot
Your next arrow roots the target in place for 3 s.
Eagle Eye
For 15 s: arrows fly 30% faster and you see every enemy within 32 blocks glowing.
Retreating Shot
Leap 4 blocks backward along the ground and fire an arrow at the nearest enemy in front.
Quiver Refill
Conjure 16 arrows into your inventory (once every 2 minutes).

martial.name: Rogue
ideas: Smoke Bomb
Throw a smoke cloud (4 blocks, 6 s): enemies inside get Blindness and lose track of you; you get Invisibility while inside.
Cheap Shot
Your next melee hit on an enemy that isn't targeting you deals double damage and stuns it for 2 s.
Poisoned Blade
For 12 s your melee hits apply Poison II for 4 s.
Pickpocket
Touch an enemy: it drops one random item from its loot table (once per creature).
Vanish
Become invisible for 6 s and drop the aggro of every enemy within 16 blocks.
Caltrops
Scatter caltrops in a 3-block area for 10 s: enemies walking over them take 2 damage and get Slowness II.

martial.name: Beastmaster
martial.has: Tamed animals are stronger and share your potions.
ideas: Call of the Pack
Summon 2 wolves that fight for you for 30 s.
Sic 'Em
Every tamed animal within 16 blocks attacks the enemy you look at and gets Strength II for 8 s.
Mend Beast
Heal every tamed animal within 12 blocks for 10 and give them Regeneration I for 10 s.
Feral Bond
For 12 s you share damage with your nearest tamed animal: each of you takes half of what either takes.
Stampede
3 summoned boars charge forward 12 blocks, knocking enemies aside and dealing 5 damage each.
Beast Sense
For 20 s every creature within 32 blocks glows, coloured by whether it's hostile.

martial.name: Cavalry
martial.has: Better tamed horses; no fall damage mounted.
ideas: Mounted Charge
While riding: your mount surges forward for 3 s at double speed; enemies you run into take 6 damage and are knocked back.
Summon Steed
Summon a saddled warhorse for 60 s (vanishes when you dismount).
Lance Thrust
While riding: your next melee hit deals +100% damage scaled by your speed.
Trample
While riding: enemies within 2 blocks of your mount take 3 damage a second for 6 s.
Rally the Horse
Heal your mount for 12 and give it Speed II and Resistance I for 10 s.
Unhorse
Knock the target off whatever it rides and stun it for 2 s.

martial.name: Duelist
martial.has: +10% damage when the target is alone; parries restore stamina.
ideas: En Garde
Mark one enemy for 15 s: you deal +20% damage to it and take 20% less damage from it.
Perfect Parry
For 1.5 s, the next melee hit you take is fully blocked and its attacker is stunned for 2 s.
Lunge
Thrust forward 4 blocks along the ground, hitting the first enemy for +50% damage.
Flourish
A quick 3-hit combo on the enemy in front, each hit 60% of your attack damage.
Disarm
The target drops its held weapon and deals 30% less damage for 6 s.
Riposte Stance
For 6 s, every melee hit you take is answered with an automatic counter for 75% of your attack damage.

martial.name: Guardian
martial.has: Guarding costs less stamina; nearby players take 5% less damage.
ideas: Intercept
Mark an ally for 10 s: 40% of the damage it takes is redirected to you.
Shield Wall
For 6 s, allies standing behind you take 30% less damage from the front.
Hold Fast
For 8 s you can't be knocked back and gain +4 armour.
Rallying Guard
Every player within 8 blocks gains 6 absorption hearts for 10 s.
Taunting Shout
Every enemy within 10 blocks is forced to attack you for 5 s.
Retaliation
For 8 s, enemies that hit you take 3 damage and get Slowness I.

martial.name: Skirmisher
ideas: Hit and Fade
Strike the enemy in front, then dash 4 blocks backward along the ground.
Harrier
For 10 s, each hit you land on a different enemy gives +5% speed (stacks 5 times).
Throwing Knives
Throw 3 knives in a fan, 4 damage each.
Tripwire
Place an invisible tripwire trap: the first enemy to cross it is knocked down (stunned) for 2 s and slowed for 4 s.
Evasion
For 5 s, you have a 40% chance to dodge any attack completely.
Flanking Strike
Your next hit from the side or behind deals +60% damage.

martial.name: Crossbowman
martial.has: Faster crossbow reload; bolts pierce one extra target.
ideas: Explosive Bolt
Your next crossbow bolt explodes on impact for 6 damage in 3 blocks (no block damage).
Volley Fire
Fire 3 bolts at once in a narrow spread from your loaded crossbow.
Pavise
Plant a wooden shield for 15 s that blocks projectiles coming from the front.
Heavy Bolt
Your next bolt deals double damage and knocks the target back 5 blocks.
Steady Aim
Crouch still for 2 s: your next bolt crits for +75% damage.
Chain Bolt
Your next bolt bounces from its target to 2 more enemies within 6 blocks.

martial.name: Spearman
ideas: Phalanx
For 10 s, enemies that come within 3 blocks in front of you take 4 damage and are pushed back.
Skewer
A long thrust that hits every enemy in a 5-block line in front of you.
Javelin Toss
Throw a spectral javelin that deals 8 damage and pins the target (rooted 2 s).
Sweep the Legs
Spin your spear: every enemy within 4 blocks is knocked down (stunned) for 1.5 s.
Brace
For 4 s, the first enemy to charge or leap at you takes double damage from your counter.
Pike Wall
A row of spikes rises from the ground in front of you for 8 s; enemies touching them take 3 damage a second.

martial.name: Monster Hunter
martial.has: +15% damage to undead and arthropods; extra drops.
ideas: Silver Oil
For 20 s your weapon deals +4 damage to undead and sets them on fire.
Monster Lore
Look at a creature: it glows for 15 s and takes 15% more damage from you and your allies.
Hunter's Net
Throw a net that roots the target for 4 s (arthropods for 6 s).
Ward Circle
A 5-block circle for 10 s that undead and arthropods can't enter.
Trophy Strength
Each undead or arthropod you killed in the last 60 s gives +4% damage (up to 40%) for 30 s.
Bane Bomb
Throw a bomb that deals 10 damage to undead and arthropods and 4 to others in 4 blocks.

martial.name: Bounty Hunter
martial.has: +10% damage to illagers and witches; captains drop emeralds.
ideas: Wanted Poster
Mark a target for 30 s: it glows, and killing it gives 4-8 emeralds.
Bola
Throw a bola that wraps the target: it is rooted for 3 s and can't attack for 1.5 s.
Manacles
A target below 30% health is stunned for 4 s.
Tracker's Instinct
Every illager, witch and pillager within 48 blocks glows for 20 s.
Dead or Alive
Your next hit on a marked or stunned target deals +80% damage.
Hired Muscle
Summon a vindicator mercenary that fights for you for 30 s.

martial.name: Battle Mage
martial.has: Spells cost 10% less mana within 3 s of a melee hit.
ideas: Spellblade
For 10 s your melee hits deal +3 magic damage and restore 2 mana each.
Arcane Shield
Gain absorption equal to 20% of your current mana for 8 s.
Mana Burst
Spend 30 mana: an arcane blast around you deals 6 damage and knocks enemies back 4 blocks.
Runic Strike
Your next melee hit releases a magic missile at the nearest other enemy.
Mana Leech
For 10 s, melee hits steal 3 mana from the target (or 1 health if it has no mana).
Overchannel
For 8 s, spells cost 30% more mana but deal 25% more damage.

martial.name: Sentinel
martial.has: Resistance I after standing still 2 s; projectiles deal 20% less.
ideas: Watchtower
Plant yourself for 8 s: you can't move but gain Resistance II and +30% ranged damage.
Arrow Deflection
For 5 s, projectiles that hit you bounce back at their shooter.
Lookout
For 20 s, every enemy within 40 blocks glows and you get Night Vision.
Alarm Ward
Place a ward for 2 minutes: when an enemy comes within 10 blocks, it rings and the enemy glows.
Stand Firm
For 6 s every ally within 6 blocks can't be knocked back and gains +2 armour.
Overwatch
For 10 s, any enemy that attacks an ally within 12 blocks is hit by an arrow from you automatically.

martial.name: Paladin
ideas: Lay on Hands
Heal yourself or the ally you look at for 10 and clear its negative effects.
Holy Smite
A light strikes the target for 6 damage (12 to undead) and blinds it for 2 s.
Aura of Devotion
For 15 s, allies within 8 blocks take 10% less damage and regenerate 1 health every 2 s.
Consecrate
Bless the ground in 4 blocks for 8 s: undead in it take 3 damage a second and burn.
Divine Shield
Become immune to damage for 2 s but deal 50% less damage for 6 s.
Oath of Vengeance
Mark the enemy that last hurt an ally: you deal +25% damage to it for 15 s.

martial.name: Corsair
martial.has: +15% damage in a boat or ship; can't drown for 15 s.
ideas: Boarding Hook
Fire a grappling hook that pulls the target to you.
Grapeshot
A pistol blast in a short cone: 3 pellets for 4 damage each.
Sea Shanty
For 15 s, you and allies within 10 blocks get +20% attack speed and Water Breathing.
Plunder
Hit a creature to make it drop gold nuggets and one random loot item (once per creature).
Powder Keg
Throw a keg that bursts after 2 s for 8 damage in 3 blocks (no block damage).
Riptide Slash
Swing a wave forward: enemies in a 5-block cone take 5 damage and are pushed back; stronger in water.

martial.name: Zealot
martial.has: Stamina regenerates 10% faster below half health.
ideas: Flagellate
Lose 4 health to gain Strength II and Speed I for 10 s.
Martyrdom
For 10 s, damage you take heals every ally within 8 blocks for half of it.
Fanatic's Fury
The lower your health, the more damage you deal for 12 s (up to +50% at 1 heart).
Burning Faith
Your melee hits set targets on fire for 6 s; you get Fire Resistance while it lasts (12 s).
Unbroken
For 8 s you can't drop below 1 health; then you heal 4.
Sermon of Wrath
Every enemy within 8 blocks gets Weakness I and Slowness I for 6 s; allies get Strength I.

job.name: Blacksmith
ideas: Field Repair
Repair 25% of the durability of the armour and weapon you hold or wear.
Whetstone
Your held weapon deals +2 damage for 60 s.
Temper Armour
You and an ally you look at gain +3 armour and +1 toughness for 30 s.
Hammer Strike
A heavy blow for +50% damage that shreds 3 armour from the target for 8 s.
Forge Heat
Smelt every raw ore in your inventory instantly (once every 5 minutes).
Sparks
Strike your weapon: sparks set enemies within 3 blocks on fire for 3 s.

job.name: Cleric
ideas: Blessing
Give the ally you look at (or yourself) Regeneration II and Resistance I for 10 s.
Purify
Clear every negative effect from you and allies within 6 blocks.
Sanctuary
A 5-block circle for 10 s: allies in it heal 1 health a second; enemies can't hit from inside it.
Turn Undead
Undead within 10 blocks flee from you for 6 s and get Weakness II.
Holy Water
Conjure 3 splash potions of Healing (once every 3 minutes).
Revive Prayer
The next time an ally within 16 blocks would die in the next 30 s, it is left at 4 health instead.

job.name: Cook
job.has: Better crafted food; more smoker XP.
ideas: Field Rations
Conjure 4 hearty rations (8 hunger, +Saturation) once every 5 minutes.
Feast
Lay out a feast for 20 s: players who stand by it regenerate health and hunger and get Strength I for 60 seconds.
Hot Pepper
Throw a pepper: the target catches fire and you get Haste I for 20 s.
Iron Stomach
Cure poison, hunger and nausea and become immune to them for 60 s.
Spice Mix
For 5 minutes, every food you eat also gives Speed I and Regeneration I for 10 s.
Frying Pan
A pan bash for 5 damage that stuns the target for 1.5 s with a loud clang.

job.name: Farmer
job.has: More crop drops; better bone meal.
ideas: Bountiful Harvest
Every crop within 6 blocks grows one stage instantly.
Scarecrow
Place a scarecrow for 60 s: hostile mobs within 8 blocks get Slowness I and target it first.
Pitchfork Thrust
A long jab for 5 damage that knocks the target back 4 blocks.
Sow the Field
Plant the seeds in your inventory on every empty farmland within 5 blocks.
Sun's Blessing
In daylight: Regeneration I and Saturation for 15 s.
Compost
Turn rotten flesh, seeds and saplings in your inventory into bone meal.

job.name: Merchant
ideas: Haggle
For 5 minutes, villager trades cost 20% less (Hero of the Village I).
Coin Toss
Throw a gold coin: on heads you get Luck II and Speed I for 20 s; on tails the target takes 6 damage.
Bribe
Spend 3 emeralds: the hostile mob you look at stops attacking you for 15 s.
Appraise
Look at an item or creature to see its value or loot; you get Luck I for 60 s.
Caravan Guard
Summon an iron-golem guard for 30 s (once every 5 minutes).
Golden Purse
Each kill in the next 60 s drops 1-3 extra gold nuggets.

job.name: Rancher
ideas: Lasso
Throw a lasso that pulls the animal or mob you hit 6 blocks toward you and slows it for 3 s.
Herd Call
Every farm animal within 24 blocks walks to you.
Bull Rush
Summon a charging bull that runs 10 blocks forward, hitting enemies for 6 damage and knocking them aside.
Shear Fortune
Animals within 8 blocks drop wool, milk or eggs as if sheared, milked or laid (once every 5 minutes).
Fatten Up
Baby animals within 8 blocks grow up instantly.
Branding Iron
Brand a creature: it glows for 60 s and drops double loot if you kill it.

job.name: Miner
job.has: Faster stone mining; no mining exhaustion.
ideas: Ore Sense
Ores within 12 blocks show through walls for 10 s (as glowing particles).
Hard Hat
For 30 s: Resistance I and immunity to damage from falling blocks and suffocation.
Miner's Lamp
Night Vision for 3 minutes and a 5-block light that follows you.
Pickaxe Strike
A heavy blow with a pickaxe for +60% damage that shreds 4 armour for 8 s.
Cave Instinct
For 20 s, every mob within 24 blocks glows (including ones behind walls).
Rock Skin
For 12 s you gain +6 armour but -15% movement speed.

job.name: Lumberjack
job.has: Fells whole trees; more planks from logs.
ideas: Timber!
A huge axe swing in front of you: every enemy in a 4-block arc takes +50% damage and is knocked down for 1 s.
Log Throw
Hurl a log that rolls 10 blocks forward, hitting enemies for 6 damage and knocking them back.
Woodsman's Grit
For 15 s: Resistance I and Haste II.
Plant Saplings
Plant one sapling from your inventory on every grass or dirt block within 4 blocks (up to 8).
Splinter
Your next axe hit makes the target bleed for 1 damage a second for 6 s.
Forest Friend
In a forest biome: Regeneration I and +10% speed for 30 s.

job.name: Explorer
job.has: Explorer kit; no sprint exhaustion; Trailblazer.
ideas: Compass Sense
Show the direction and distance of the nearest structure for 10 s.
Second Wind
Restore all your stamina and hunger once every 5 minutes.
Trail Marker
Place a glowing marker that shows through walls for 10 minutes (up to 3 at once).
Pathfinder
For 30 s: +20% speed and step up full blocks without jumping.
Grappling Rope
Fire a rope that pulls the creature you hit toward you (no pulling yourself).
Campfire Rest
Set up a camp for 20 s: players next to it regenerate 2 health a second and hunger.

job.name: Alchemist
job.has: Helpful effects last 25% longer; XP from brewing.
ideas: Acid Flask
Throw a flask that deals 4 damage and shreds 4 armour from everything in 3 blocks for 8 s.
Transmute
Turn 8 iron nuggets into 1 gold ingot or 4 gold nuggets into 1 emerald (once every 5 minutes).
Elixir of Vigor
Drink: Strength I, Speed I and Haste I for 30 s.
Volatile Mix
Throw a flask that bursts into a random harmful cloud (poison, slowness, weakness or blindness) for 6 s.
Distill
Double the duration of every positive effect you have right now (up to 5 minutes).
Antidote
Cure every negative effect on you and allies within 4 blocks and give them immunity to poison for 30 s.

job.name: Sailor
job.has: Breath lasts twice as long; ships you steer go 15% faster.
ideas: Tailwind
For 30 s the boat or ship you ride goes 40% faster.
Knot Tying
Throw a rope that ties the target down: rooted for 3 s.
Deep Breath
Water Breathing and Dolphin's Grace for 60 s.
Swab the Deck
A broad swing that pushes every enemy within 3 blocks 4 blocks back.
Weather Eye
See the weather for the next 10 minutes and get Conduit Power for 30 s.
Anchor Drop
Slam an anchor down: enemies within 3 blocks take 6 damage and are slowed heavily for 3 s.

job.name: Fisher
job.has: Fish bite sooner, catches can double; fish feeds more.
ideas: Hook and Reel
Cast a hook that pulls the creature you hit 6 blocks toward you.
Lucky Catch
Your next 3 fishing catches are from the treasure table.
Fish Slap
Slap the target with a fish: 4 damage, knockback, and it gets Nausea for 4 s.
Chum the Water
For 60 s, fish bite twice as fast within 8 blocks of the spot you look at.
Net Throw
Throw a net that roots every creature in a 3-block area for 3 s.
Shore Lunch
Cook every raw fish in your inventory instantly; you heal 2 for each one cooked (up to 10).

job.name: Bard
job.has: Goat horn rallies nearby players; +10% XP near other players.
ideas: Song of Courage
For 20 s, allies within 10 blocks get +10% attack damage and +10% attack speed.
Lullaby
Enemies within 8 blocks fall asleep (can't move or attack) for 4 s or until hit.
Discordant Note
A shrill note: enemies in a 6-block cone take 4 damage and get Weakness I for 6 s.
Ballad of Rest
For 15 s, allies within 10 blocks regenerate 1 health a second.
Encore
Refresh the duration of every positive effect on allies within 10 blocks.
Inspiring Tale
Allies within 16 blocks gain 25% more experience for 5 minutes.

job.name: Herbalist
job.has: More flowers when picking; suspicious stew lasts twice as long.
ideas: Poultice
Heal yourself or the ally you look at for 8 and stop bleeding and poison.
Thornbush
A ring of thorny bushes grows around you for 10 s; enemies that touch it take 2 damage and are slowed.
Sleeping Draught
Throw a pouch of herbs: every creature in 3 blocks gets Slowness IV and Weakness for 5 s.
Healing Garden
Flowers bloom in a 4-block circle for 12 s; allies in it get Regeneration I.
Herb Lore
Every plant and flower within 16 blocks glows for 20 s, and your next 5 picks drop double.
Nettle Sting
Your melee hits in the next 10 s give the target Poison I for 3 s.

job.name: Beekeeper
job.has: Bees never sting you; extra honeycomb from hives.
ideas: Swarm
Release 4 bees that attack the enemy you look at for 15 s (they don't die after stinging).
Honey Trap
Throw honey on the ground for 8 s: enemies in a 3-block patch are slowed heavily and can't jump.
Royal Jelly
Heal 6 and get Regeneration II for 6 s.
Smoke Calm
Every mob within 8 blocks that isn't a boss stops attacking for 5 s.
Pollinate
Crops and flowers within 6 blocks grow one stage, and nearby bees fill their hives faster for 60 s.
Stinger Shot
Fire 3 stingers that deal 3 damage and Poison I for 4 s each.

job.name: Gravedigger
job.has: Faster with shovels; extra undead loot; starts with a lantern.
ideas: Shovel Slam
A wide shovel swing: enemies in a 3-block arc take +40% damage and are knocked down for 1 s.
Rest in Peace
Undead within 6 blocks are stunned for 3 s and take 6 damage.
Grave Lantern
A ghostly lantern lights the area for 2 minutes and makes undead within 12 blocks glow.
Exhume
Dig up a grave at your feet: drops bones, rotten flesh and one random loot item (once every 5 minutes).
Mourner's Veil
For 15 s, undead ignore you unless you attack them.
Bone Collector
Every undead you kill in the next 60 s heals you for 3.
